README.md.content:
# Education Ops for a Weekly-Shipping IDE

> Product changes faster than docs. Your job is launch coupling and lifecycle hygiene.

## What you will learn

- Map artifact types (path / lab / workshop / reference)
- Write a launch Definition of Done
- Cut / keep / why when UI changes mid-production
- Deprecate without orphaning learners
- Hire education engineers with the right rubric

Misses reduce score. Pass at **70%**.

Backlog/content-architecture.md.content:
# Content architecture

- **Path** — sequenced outcomes
- **Lab** — do-with-product practice
- **Workshop** — facilitated cohort
- **Reference** — searchable truth

Misfiling artifacts is how catalogs rot.

InLaunch/launch-dod.md.content:
# Launch Definition of Done (edit)

Capability ships with:
- [ ] tutorial
- [ ] path update
- [ ] deprecate note for old UI

InLaunch/capability-agent-layout.md.content:
# Capability: Agent layout v2

UI moved Agent to the right rail. Old screenshots in Composer tutorial are wrong.

Deprecated/old-composer-tutorial.md.content:
# DEPRECATED — Composer-only tutorial

Keep conceptual bits; cut UI screenshots; redirect to Agent Fluent path.

Cases/mid-flight-redesign.md.content:
# Case — Mid-flight redesign

You are 60% done filming a Composer walkthrough. Product ships Agent layout v2 tomorrow.

Cut brittle UI chrome. Keep durable concepts. Deprecate with redirect.

Hiring/education-engineer-rubric.md.content:
# Education engineer rubric

1. Reads code critically
2. Ships labs not slides
3. Measures fluency not completion
4. Comfortable in weekly ship cycles
5. Cross-functional, customer-obsessed

taxonomy-board.md.title: Artifact taxonomy
taxonomy-board.md.blurb: Drag each card into the correct column, then Validate in Coach.

missions.title: Taxonomy
missions.teach: Correct taxonomy keeps the library maintainable as the product ships weekly.
missions.brief: Drag cards to the right columns, then Validate placement.

taxonomy.fail: Check: sequence=path, IDE exercise=lab, facilitated=workshop, searchable doc=reference.

missions.title: Launch DoD
missions.teach: Launch coupling means education ships with the capability — not a week later.
missions.brief: Edit the DoD so it mentions tutorial, path, and deprecate/deprecation. Then Validate.

dod.success: Launch DoD includes tutorial, path update, and deprecation.

missions.fallbackReply: Edit the DoD file, then Validate.

missions.title: Mid-flight redesign
missions.hint: Cut UI screenshots; keep concepts; redirect.
missions.teach: This is the operating muscle for weekly-shipping products.
missions.brief: Product changed mid-production. What do you cut, keep, and why?

choices.label: Keep filming old UI — ship late is fine
choices.feedback: That creates wrong mental models at scale.

choices.label: Cut UI screenshots; keep concepts; redirect to Agent Fluent; deprecate old module
choices.feedback: Correct cut/keep/why. This is how education survives weekly ships.
choices.setBrowser:
Learner path

Old Composer tutorial marked deprecated

Redirect → Cursor Fluent M01

choices.label: Delete everything and start from zero
choices.feedback: Wasteful. Keep durable concepts; cut brittle UI chrome.

missions.fallbackReply: Choose the cut/keep option that preserves concepts and deprecates UI.

missions.title: Deprecate safely
missions.hint: Run content deprecate, then confirm redirect.
missions.teach: Deprecation without redirect creates orphan learner paths.
missions.brief: Run `content deprecate --capability agent-layout-v2`, then confirm the Browser redirect.

choices.label: Confirm redirect is live in Browser
choices.feedback: Lifecycle hygiene done — no orphan path.

content deprecate --capability agent-lay.setBrowser:
Broken? Fixed.

Old URL now redirects to Cursor Fluent.

missions.fallbackReply: Run the deprecate command, then confirm in Coach.

missions.title: Hire rubric
missions.teach: Hire for technical editorial judgment, not slide polish.
missions.brief: Candidate A: beautiful slides, never reads diffs. Candidate B: ships labs, measures fluency, rough slides. Who do you hire?

choices.label: Candidate A — polish wins
choices.feedback: Wrong signal. This role needs technical editorial judgment.

choices.label: Candidate B — labs + fluency metrics
choices.feedback: Yes. Rubric beat theater. You can hire and develop education engineers.

missions.fallbackReply: Pick the candidate who ships labs and measures fluency.
